about_us.label: ABOUT US
about_us.heading: Healthcare benefits shouldn't be a luxury
paragraphs: Onsurity is a fast-growing employee healthcare benefits platform. We give SMEs, start-ups and enterprises flexible healthcare subscriptions with discounted medicine, health checkups, fitness plans, free doctor teleconsultations and insurance in one membership. Our plans cover full-time employees as well as contractual workers, interns, freelancers and consultants, because inclusion is the whole point.

We've raised a __$45M Series B led by Creaegis__, count cricketing legend __Anil Kumble__ as a strategic advisor and investor, featured in season one of Disney+ Hotstar's *The Great Indian Disruptors*, and were named a __Dun & Bradstreet Start-up 50 Trailblazer__. More at [onsurity.com](https://www.onsurity.com/), or find us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/onsurity/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/onsurity/) and [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@onsurity).

eeo.label: EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
eeo.text: Onsurity is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on capability and evidence, and we're committed to an inclusive workplace. It is the same philosophy behind healthcare plans that cover the people other plans leave out.
